text: There's one island on Earth where you're not allowed to set foot... and the people living there want it that way.
This is North Sentinel Island, in India's Andaman Islands. About sixty square kilometres of jungle.
It's home to the Sentinelese, one of the last uncontacted peoples on Earth. Nobody knows how many there are.
In eighteen eighty, British officers took a few of them away. Two reportedly fell sick and died.
Ever since, they've met outsiders with arrows. Even a helicopter, after the two thousand four tsunami.
So India made the island a protected reserve. Boats must keep their distance, and visiting is illegal.
Not just for our safety, but for theirs. A common cold could wipe them out.
They've chosen to be left alone. Would you respect that?
